text:
maria: quick note / brainstorming: propose adding tiny heartbeat-progress pings + a priority-window hint at the gateway so UIs can show meaningful degradation instead of full timeout. want to record tradeoffs and a small rollout plan.
akshay: sounds useful. what's the wire surface - header, trailers, or inline pings?
maria: header opt-in + sparse heartbeat events on streaming responses. headers: `Priority-Window: high|normal|best-effort` and `X-RW-Heartbeat: enabled=true`. heartbeats are low-cardinality strings: queued, started, first_tick, partial_tick, final.
dom: cautious: (1) cache hits can create false "final" signals; (2) backpressure/admission must be aware of the priority-window so we don't starve normal traffic.
olivia: on metrics: add span tags `heartbeat.stage` and `heartbeat.rs_ts`. reduce cardinality by bucketing progress pct (0,25,50,75,100) and only annotate model_variant on stage transitions.
maria: sample heartbeat line (opt-in only, small): `hb_id=pulse-1; stage=partial_tick; bucket=50; variant=small-fallback; attempt=1` — attempt increments on retries.
akshay: SDKs map Priority-Window to UI/backoff heuristics. server-side, admission_score = base - priority_penalty - age_penalty. reserve soft-window (eg 15%) of concurrency for high priority so in-flight high calls are not evicted by bursts.
dom: eviction policy: preempt low-priority only if admission below threshold and low call has not reached first_tick. define stage enums: 0=queued,1=started,2=first_tick,3=partial,4=final.
maria: privacy note: heartbeats leak timing/model hints. keep opt-in and disabled by default for private deployments; allow org-level opt-out.
olivia: alerts: `p95 time_to_first_tick > 2s` for high-priority routes; metrics: `heartbeat.emitted`, `heartbeat.missing`. sampling flag to avoid cardinality explosion.
akshay: rollout: feature-flag `heartbeat-v1`, prototype on chat-beta route, emit sparse heartbeats every ~1.5-2s or on stage change, SDK opt-in + README, measure noise for 7 days.
ci-bot: deploy queued for feature/heartbeat-v1 to staging at 1746667899 — CI green.
maria: owners: @akshay build prototype emitter, @olivia metrics, @dom eviction params, i'll write RFC follow-up with concrete enums and admission math. :thumbsup:
